data.body:
Phase 2 implementation evidence before commit: held-out workflow truth-table oracle was RED on origin/main because Ubuntu 3.11 and 3.12 received both coverage flags. The fixer did not inspect tests and changed only the workflow/docs. Reapplied oracle was GREEN (1 passed). Exact defect seed restoring the prior all-Ubuntu condition returned RED naming 3.11/3.12; zero-coverage seed returned RED naming Ubuntu 3.13; restored fix returned GREEN. Full workflow-parity file: 19 passed. `make lint` passed (including actionlint), `make typecheck` passed (539 files), `make config-check` passed, `git diff --check` passed.

Final contract: all four matrix cells remain; default and integration tier commands remain; only Ubuntu 3.13 receives the exact existing coverage flags; branch=true and fail_under=70 remain centralized and unchanged. No dependency added and no pre-existing assertion, test, marker, matrix cell, or tier was removed/weakened. Construct sweep found one coverage expression. Parity sweep: both pre-merge Gerrit and post-merge branch lanes consume this same reusable workflow, so no parallel surface is missing the rule. Refactoring litmus passes because the oracle parses shipped workflow behavior (expanded cells/tier commands/flag outcomes), not implementation variable names.
